summary: Validated live Expo dashboard, queue search, stage filtering, applicant detail opening, and backend regressions. Backend checks passed; the mobile detail stage control could not be tapped because the horizontal stage row places the selected pill outside the viewport.

ui_bugs.issue: On 390x844, stage-admitted is rendered outside the viewport and Playwright cannot tap it after detail opens; horizontal stage controls need reliable auto-scroll or a layout that keeps actions tappable.

action_items: Fix ApplicantDetail horizontal stage control behavior so every stage remains tappable at 390px width; then retest stage and document persistence plus UI creation flow.
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend API base uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL rather than the requested EXPO_BACKEND_URL key; confirm this is intentional and consistently configured.
Filter testIDs preserve stage capitalization (filter-Documents), unlike the kebab-case accessibility guideline.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST applicant APP-ITER2-API via regression test; it is retained in the shared database.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Overview loaded at 390x844 with no horizontal body overflow. Applications search worked (Aarav returned one row). Documents filter works using [data-testid=filter-Documents]. Detail opens. Stage action is outside viewport; do not repeat selector retries without fixing layout/scroll behavior.
rca_of_issue: ApplicantDetail places four stage pills in a horizontal ScrollView. At mobile width, the final pill is beyond the visible area and the web renderer's automatic scroll does not produce a tappable viewport position. The same interaction risk applies to later stage/document workflow verification.
